senses.gloss: m. (v. next art.) an inferior kind of beans (cmp. פַּיְישׂוֹנָא).
units: Ab. Zar. 38ᵇ היא המטליא היא פ׳ וכ׳ Ar. (Ms. M. פסליא; ed. פשליא) the same law applies to gentile preparations of hemṭalia, psilia and sh’ʿitha, v. הֵמְטַלְיָא a. שְׁעִיתָא.
